name: Attack Titan
desc: A titan that has always fought for freedom throughout the generations. It possesses incredible combat capabilities and a unique connection to its future inheritors.

name: Armored Titan
desc: Covered in hardened, armor-like skin that can withstand massive artillery fire. It specializes in brute-force breaching.

name: Colossal Titan
desc: The God of Destruction. Its sheer size is unmatched, and it can emit scorching steam to incinerate anything near it.

name: Female Titan
desc: Exceptionally versatile. Capable of selective crystallization and attracting pure titans with her scream.

name: Beast Titan
desc: An ape-like titan with immense throwing power. Can command pure titans created through his spinal fluid.
